'''"Kuati First Holo-News"''' was a galactic news agency during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. One of their [[Journalist|reporters]], [[Zaree Lolvanci]], tried to interview [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] during the [[trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] of his fellow Rogue [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]].<ref name="KT" />
